title: Developer Task Delegation to LLMs and the Trust Factor: A Mixed Methods Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.34317v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), software developers are presented with a powerful new approach: delegating software development tasks to LLMs. Existing studies have explored task delegation for a subset of tasks and factors. Critically, what tasks developers delegate to LLMs, to what extent, and why they delegate them, is not yet well understood. We explore these questions through 22 interviews and a survey with 160 software practitioners. Developers reported employing four modes of task delegation to LLMs: full delegation, partial delegation, self-delegation, and task avoidance. Drawing on our qualitative findings, we discuss the rationales behind these choices and explore how task difficulty, task risk, developer motivation, and trust appear to be associated with software development task delegation to LLMs. Our statistical analysis reveals that trust is a significant factor associated with task delegation to LLMs. Fin

translated_title: 开发者向大语言模型委派任务及信任因素：一项混合方法研究
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的兴起，软件开发者迎来了一种强大的新方式：将软件开发任务委派给大语言模型。现有研究仅针对部分任务和因素探索了任务委派问题。关键在于，开发者将哪些任务委派给大语言模型、委派到何种程度、以及为什么委派这些任务，目前尚不明确。我们通过22次访谈和对160名软件从业者的问卷调查来探索这些问题。开发者报告了向大语言模型委派任务的四种模式：完全委派、部分委派、自我委派和任务回避。基于我们的定性研究结果，我们讨论了这些选择背后的原因，并探讨了任务难度、任务风险、开发者动机和信任如何与向大语言模型委派软件开发任务相关联。我们的统计分析表明，信任是与向大语言模型委派任务相关的一个显著因素。
tldr: 该研究通过22次访谈和160名从业者的问卷调查，首次系统揭示了开发者向大语言模型委派任务的四种模式（完全委派、部分委派、自我委派和任务回避），并通过统计分析证明信任是影响任务委派决策的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This mixed-methods study, based on 22 interviews and a survey of 160 practitioners, identifies four modes of developer task delegation to LLMs (full delegation, partial delegation, self-delegation, and task avoidance) and statistically shows that trust is a significant factor associated with task delegation to LLMs.
